string-array.name: help_formats
string-array.item: XP3 (.xp3) — Extract & Pack\nKirikiri archive; zlib levels 0-9; edit scripts in-place (Edit → unpack → edit → Repack as name-cn.xp3)
PFS / PF6 / PF8 — Extract & Pack\nArtemis archive; pack outputs PF8 (XOR-encrypted); edit scripts in-place (Repack as name-cn.pfs)

NSA / SAR (.nsa/.sar) — Extract & Pack\nNScripter archive (LZSS + SPB); pack with LZSS (raw fallback when it does not shrink); edit scripts in-place (Repack as name-cn.nsa)\nLimits: SPB bitmap entries have a 2GB cap; archives over 4GiB cannot be packed
ISO 9660 (.iso) — Extract & Pack\nDisc images (CD/DVD/BD); pack (Level 1) and convert to PSP CISO (CSO)\nLimits: pack uses 8.3 uppercase filenames and a 1GiB total cap; files over 4GiB are rejected
CSO (.cso) — Convert\nPSP compressed ISO; tap a .cso to convert back to ISO; ISO previews offer Convert to CSO\nLimit: data area is capped at 2GiB by the format (31-bit offsets)
YPF (.ypf) — Extract only\nYU-RIS archive; filenames are XOR + Shift-JIS obfuscated, key auto-detected

ZIP (.zip) — Extract & Pack
AES-256 encryption, 5 levels (0 = store), encoding switchable UTF-8/SHIFT-JIS/GBK
In-place entry management: edit / delete / add entries (non-split archives only)
Limits: byte-split .zip.001 and PKWARE multi-disk .z01/.z02/.zip extract (incl. cross-disk entries); multi-disk archives cannot be edited
7z (.7z) — Extract & Pack\nLevels 0/3/6/9/12; setting a password also encrypts headers (listing needs the password); .7z.001 volumes supported

RAR (.rar) — Extract only\nRAR4/5, password + volumes supported; no compression (RARLAB license)\nNote: header-encrypted RAR listing is limited — use the password retry on extract; encrypted many-small-file archives extract slowly (per-file key derivation)
LZ4 (.lz4) — Extract & Pack\nLZ4 frame format; output is capped to prevent decompression bombs
GZIP (.gz) — Extract & Pack\nSupports concatenated multi-member files; output capped at the declared size
BZIP2 (.bz2) — Extract & Pack\nOutput capped (no size in header) to prevent bombs
XZ (.xz) — Extract & Pack\nliblzma, compression levels 0-9; output capped
ZSTD (.zst) — Extract & Pack\nOutput capped (no size in header) to prevent bombs
LZMA (.lzma) — Extract & Pack\nNote: preview list does not show decompressed size (alone header has no size)
TAR — Extract & Pack\n.tar / .tar.gz / .tgz / .tar.bz2 / .tbz2 / .tar.xz / .txz / .tar.zst / .tzst
KSD (.ksd) — Extract & Pack\nKirikiri2 save; packing accepts .txt only
BROTLI (.br) — Extract & Pack\nGoogle Brotli compression; levels 0-11 (default 6); widely used for web content

RPG Maker MV/MZ (.rpgmvp/.rpgmvo/.rpgmvm) — Extract & Pack
Obfuscated per-file assets: pictures (.rpgmvp), sounds (.rpgmvo), movies (.rpgmvm). The 16-byte header is recovered from the file itself, so no key is needed; the output is named with the real extension and opens in the image / audio viewer
Also covers RPG Maker MZ's .png_ / .ogg_ / .m4a_. Files that are not obfuscated (repacked games) are copied through untouched
Note: one tap shows the decoded file as a single-entry archive — tap it again for the image / audio preview; batch mode decrypts a whole folder at once
Packing obfuscates a single asset (foo.png → foo.rpgmvp) with the keystream you type in the pack options: 32 hex digits are used as-is, any other text is MD5-hashed the way RPG Maker does it, and empty gives the default key. Batch mode obfuscates a whole selection at once. Each key takes only its own type: .rpgmvp packs .png, .rpgmvo packs .ogg, .rpgmvm packs .m4a — anything else is refused

RGSS (.rgssad/.rgss2a/.rgss3a) — Extract & Pack
RPG Maker encrypted archives: XP (.rgssad), VX (.rgss2a), VX Ace (.rgss3a). The layout is picked from the header, so any of the three opens any of the three; names are UTF-8 / Shift-JIS
Packing offers the target version; edit scripts in-place (Repack as name-cn.rgss3a). Packed output is named Game.rgss3a by default, because that is the only name RPG Maker opens (toggleable in the pack options)
Note: RPG Maker only loads an archive named Game.rgss3a (or .rgssad / .rgss2a) sitting next to the game .exe — rename the output and drop it back into the game folder
Limits: v3 offsets are 32-bit, so a packed archive cannot pass 4GiB

string-array.name: help_tutorials
string-array.item: Compression settings\nSettings → Compression: levels (zip/7z/generic), split size (zip/7z), ZIP encoding, password; "OK" saves everything at once; the work mode (archive/compress) updates the title bar

Global search\nTop menu → Global search: filename / content modes; content search first asks for a per-file size cap; tap a result to preview with match highlighting and prev/next jump; tap "Continue scan" when results are truncated
Search inside an archive\nOpen an archive preview, tap the search icon: text files are unpacked first, then the global search runs over them; tapping a result extracts the real file on demand

Batch operations\nLong-press to multi-select; the batch bar offers preview / extract / compress / delete / move; navigating to another folder auto-exits multi-select. Batch preview (same format only) shows several archives at once and lets you pick files across all of them

Volumes\nExtract: tap any part of .7z.001 / .zip.001 / .z01 / .part01.rar and it is joined automatically; PKWARE multi-disk (.z01/.z02/.zip) is read as separate disks (entries may cross disk boundaries). Pack: pick a split size for zip/7z (none/1MB/100MB/1GB/custom), output is .001/.002… (7-Zip compatible)

Passwords\nEnter the password once when previewing an encrypted zip/7z/rar; "Extract all / selected" then reuse it without re-prompting; batch operations ask once; password-protected archives show a 🔒 badge
Bookmarks\nStar a folder (row star or drawer "+ add current path"); deleting a folder cleans up its bookmark automatically; long-press a bookmark to remove it
File info\nLong-press a file → Info: shows size/date/MD5/SHA-256 with one-tap copy
Interaction flow\nTap an archive → bottom-right button → direct archive preview (format auto-detected); "Extract all" unpacks to a sibling folder, "Extract selected" lets you choose the destination

Signature scan (binwalk)\nLong-press a file → Scan: detects embedded archive/image signatures (e.g. a ZIP embedded inside a video), listing offsets and formats with ZIP file counts. Each hit has two buttons: "Extract" opens archives directly for preview/extraction, "Carve (dd)" saves the raw segment as a standalone file; failures show the specific reason

Edit scripts inside an archive\nOpen an XP3/PFS/ISO/NSA preview and tap "Edit": the archive is unpacked, a script list (.ks/.tjs/.csv/…) appears, tap one to edit with an explicit encoding (the original byte order is kept on save), then "Repack" creates a new "name-cn.xp3/pfs/iso/nsa" in the same folder. ISO repack uses Level-1 8.3 names with a 1GiB cap

Edit ZIP entries in place\nIn a ZIP preview, tap "Entries": delete selected entries (with confirmation) or add a new entry from a local file (pick a file, name it, added as deflate). Untouched entries keep their exact bytes. Split-volume ZIPs cannot be edited

Merge into another archive\nIn a preview, tick the entries to contribute, then tap Merge at the bottom (it greys out when there is nothing to merge into). The target list is grouped: archives in the folder you are browsing, plus archives other windows currently have open. Your entries are unpacked, the target is unpacked over the same staging folder — so matching paths are overwritten by yours — and the result is repacked as a "target-cn.ext" copy beside the target. The target is only read and the original is never modified, so merging into an archive another window is previewing is safe. Encrypted targets ask for their password first, and that prompt appears before the progress bar so other windows are not blocked

RPG Maker packing (RGSS / MV / MZ)\nRGSS: pick .rgssad / .rgss2a / .rgss3a plus a version; the output is named Game.rgss3a by default because that is the ONLY name RPG Maker opens (toggle in the pack options for a different name). Editing a script and repacking keeps the source archive\'s version, so a .rgss3a stays v3. MV/MZ: one asset in, one asset out — hero.png becomes hero.rpgmvp (the extension is replaced, not appended). Each key takes only its own type (.rpgmvp packs .png, .rpgmvo packs .ogg, .rpgmvm packs .m4a) and anything else is refused before you type a key, because RPG Maker picks its loader from the extension. The keystream field takes 32 hex digits verbatim, or any text to be MD5-hashed the way RPG Maker does it; empty gives the default key

Image editor\nFrom the image preview ⋮ menu. Brush (palette + opacity + width — every stroke keeps the opacity it was drawn at, so changing it later never restyles earlier work), rectangular crop, stretch to 1:1 / 4:3 / 3:4 / 16:9 / 9:16, pixel eyedropper, two-finger pinch zoom (1–8×) + pan, undo / reset. Saves a "name-edit.png" copy; the original is never overwritten

Preview workspace\nFrom an archive preview, open a workspace to browse the extracted contents as a real folder in its own window. Useful when the archive holds many small files you want to preview, edit or extract one by one; the workspace keeps the preview\'s password so there is no re-prompt

Encoding & garbled text\nEvery preview/editor shows an encoding row — tap it to switch UTF-8/Shift-JIS/GBK/UTF-16 and the text re-renders instantly. UTF-16/UTF-8 files with a byte-order mark open with the right encoding automatically; a "looks like UTF-8" hint appears when a file was read with a wrong non-UTF-8 encoding

Scrolling & refresh\nLong lists have an always-visible draggable handle on the right (grab and drag to jump); the text preview/editor have a draggable scrollbar too. The file list refreshes automatically when the current folder changes (rename/move/delete/extract/compress or external changes such as USB)

Recycle bin\nDelete moves files to the recycle bin instead of permanently deleting them (configurable). Tap the recycle bin icon in the toolbar to view, restore, or permanently delete items. Auto-clean removes items after a configurable period (7/14/30/60/90 days or never). Files in the recycle bin count against storage space. Note: the recycle bin is stored in app internal storage and is cleared when the app is uninstalled
